# MODEL: Three-location timedCGS where time can diverge, for TCTL path quantifiers

# PURPOSE: s0 has invariant x<=1, a zero-time self-loop and edges to s1 (p) and s2 (q);
#          s1 and s2 have no invariant and only an unguarded self-loop, so time diverges there.
#          Looping at s0 forever is time-convergent and is not a path of TCTL;
#          every divergent path leaves s0, so AF (p || q) holds at s0 and EG (!p && !q) fails.

# LOGIC: TCTL

Transition
a b c
0 * 0
0 0 *
Name_State
s0 s1 s2
Initial_State
s0
Atomic_propositions
p q
Labelling
0 0
1 0
0 1
Number_of_agents
1
Clocks
x
Clock_constraints
x<=1 x<=1 x<=1
0 0 0
0 0 0
Invariants
x<=1
0
0
